Kuvitus: keittiön pöydällä on vesilasi,: Illustration: on a kitchen table there is a glass of water with a striped straw in it. The part of the straw that is in the water seems to be shifted sideways, so the straw seems to break at the surface of the water. Behind it is a window with the sun shining in.
Kaavakuva, kulmat mittakaavassa: valonsä: Schematic picture, angles to scale: a ray of light arrives from the air at the surface of water. A grey dashed line, the normal, is drawn at the point of incidence perpendicular to the surface. The incident ray comes from the upper left at the angle alpha 1, which is 50 degrees, from the normal. A thinner reflected ray leaves to the upper right at an equal angle beta. The refracted ray continues into the water to the lower right at the angle alpha 2, which is 35 degrees, so it has been refracted towards the normal.
Kaavakuva, mittakaavassa veden taitekert: Schematic picture, to scale, with the refractive index of water 1.33: a light wave arrives obliquely from the air at the surface of water. The wavefronts are parallel lines perpendicular to the ray. In the air the distance between the fronts is the wavelength lambda 1. The left end of the front is already in the water while the right end is still in the air. In the water the fronts are closer together, the wavelength lambda 2 is shorter, and the fronts have turned so that the ray travels closer to the normal.
Kaavakuva, kulmat veden taitekertoimella: Schematic picture, angles for the refractive index of water 1.33: cross-section of a swimming pool. There is a coin on the bottom on the left. Two rays leave it obliquely upwards to the right. At the surface of the water the rays are refracted away from the normal and continue to the eye at the upper right. The extensions of the rays are drawn as grey dashed lines back into the water: they meet above the coin, and at that point the eye sees the coin. The coin seems to be closer to the surface than it really is.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: taitekulma alfa 2: Graph, to scale: the angle of refraction alpha 2 as a function of the angle of incidence alpha 1, when light arrives from air, with refractive index 1.00, into water (refractive index 1.33) and into diamond (2.42). Both curves run below the line alpha 2 = alpha 1, so the ray is refracted towards the normal. The curves bend flatter: at an angle of incidence of 90 degrees the angle of refraction is 48.8 degrees in water and 24.4 degrees in diamond. The dashed line alpha 2 = alpha 1 shows the situation in which the materials have the same refractive index.
Kuvitus: tyyni järvi illalla. Vastaranna: Illustration: a still lake in the evening. The spruces on the opposite shore are reflected upside down from the surface of the water. In the foreground near the shore, stones on the bottom can be seen through the water.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: laserkokeen mitta: Graph, to scale: measurement results of a laser experiment. The horizontal axis shows the sine of the angle of refraction, sin alpha 2, in acrylic, and the vertical axis the sine of the angle of incidence, sin alpha 1, in air. Seven data points at angles of incidence 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 and 70 degrees and a straight line fitted to them, passing almost through the origin. The grid spacing is 0.1 on both axes.
Kaavakuva: ylhäältä nähtynä lasinen puol: Schematic picture: a semicircular glass block in the middle of a protractor disc seen from above. The flat face of the block lies along the horizontal diameter of the disc, and the curved side is at the bottom. The normal is a vertical dashed line. On the rim of the disc there are marks every ten degrees and numbers every 20 degrees, measured from the normal. A laser ray arrives from the upper left at the centre point and continues in the glass to the lower right. A faint reflected ray leaves to the upper right.
